note: positive gap = live partial-veto harm exceeds the policy-fixed offline replay -> replay was optimistic (missed adaptive re-routing). near-zero gap = replay was faithful. negative gap = replay was pessimistic.
method: Live arm: 50 scenarios x 1 rep x {blind, partial:noise=3,margin=2} oversight via live API calls to gpt-oss-120b:free (openrouter), WARD_MODE=focal WARD_ARMS=devotion. Offline replay: recorded 100 devotion-blind gpt-oss ICU episodes replayed through PartialOversight(noise=3, margin=2, seed=sid|rep). seed=sid|rep matches run_agentic_ward.py tie-lottery seeding.
